Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Cognizant Romania is home to 2400+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 About the role 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Android Software Engineer with strong Kotlin expertise to join our team and contribute to the development of scalable, high-quality Android applications.
 You will work in a collaborative engineering environment, developing new solutions, improving existing applications and working closely with engineering teams and business stakeholders. The role offers the opportunity to work with modern technologies while contributing to architecture, design and engineering best practices.
 Your responsibilities 
Design, develop and maintain scalable Android applications using Kotlin .
Build reliable, maintainable and high-performing software solutions.
Participate in code and design reviews to ensure consistency in architecture and development practices.
Develop solutions with performance, scalability and usability in mind.
Design and consume RESTful APIs , working with JSON, XML and GraphQL.
Write and maintain automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito and Espresso .
Work with SQL databases and contribute to efficient data management.
Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on new solutions and technical improvements.
Explore new technologies, tools and engineering practices.
Contribute to prototypes and continuous improvements across the development lifecycle.
Work closely with engineers, business stakeholders and other teams in a collaborative environment.
Support troubleshooting and resolution of complex technical issues.
Contribute to CI/CD, source control and software quality practices
 What you bring 
Strong hands-on experience with Kotlin , including its core features, syntax and development best practices.
Solid experience with the Android SDK , Android architecture components and frameworks.
Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs .
Good understanding of JSON, XML and GraphQL .
Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito and Espresso .
Good knowledge of SQL , query design and database management.
Understanding of software design principles for building scalable applications.
Experience with continuous integration, source control and testing best practices .
Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to write clean, maintainable and well-structured code.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Cognizant Romania Employee Benefits: 
 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Flexible Hybrid Approach – We support a hybrid working model that helps you balance remote and office work. Employees based near a Cognizant office are expected to spend a minimum of 4 days per month onsite.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
 Please note that only suitable candidates will be contacted. Cognizant and its affiliated companies are firmly committed to protecting your privacy. This Candidate Privacy Notice provides you with all the details on what we do with Personal Information we collect during and after the recruitment process.
